notes.recognition: Runners, tow loop, strapped cases, and low profile identify a survey sled even at 72 px.
notes.agency: The prop suggests hauling and supply choices; gameplay provides the explicit interaction.
notes.specificity: Weathered basalt-metal construction, modular cases, and cyan route-light seam fit Xenovoya field equipment.
notes.restraint: The silhouette is dense but controlled, with cyan limited to status and route accents.
notes.continuity: Materials, three-quarter camera, margins, and neutral light match the prop family contract.
notes.reusability: All-background alpha extraction preserves the tow-loop hole and reads cleanly on all three surfaces.
notes.accessibility: The runner-and-cargo silhouette communicates function without color.
